conventions.convention: The scale parameter ρ is positive and dimensionless. The scalar-field action is Cρφ(x)=ρ⁻¹φ(ρ⁻¹x), and functional pullback is Cρ*F=F∘Cρ⁻¹.
Scale conjugation at mass m uses the component at ρ⁻¹m: (σρAσρ⁻¹)m=Cρ*∘Aρ⁻¹m∘(Cρ*)⁻¹. Formal indeterminates are fixed.

Normalized formal S-maps have coefficients Tn/n!, with T0=1 and T1=id. Comparison maps satisfy S′=S∘Z and have identity linear term. Existence is conditional on supplied systems and same-free-data scale admissibility; Countable Choice is assumed.
The real scale coordinate is t=log ρ. Constants b and g0 are prescribed dimensionless real numbers. Maximality means absence of an IVP extension to a strictly larger interval.

Formal coupling changes are tangent to the identity: Φ(u)=u+au²+O(u³). Here O(uᵏ) denotes the ideal uᵏR[[u]], and the formal indeterminate u is distinct from the real trajectory g(t). No convergence or omitted-term estimate is assumed.

load_bearing.statement: Under Countable Choice and the supplied normalized mass-indexed systems satisfying scale admissibility, Zρ,m is the unique identity-linear formal local map satisfying Cρ*∘Sρ⁻¹m∘(Cρ*)⁻¹=Sm∘Zρ,m.

For dg/dt=bg², g(0)=g0, put c=bg0. If c=0, the unique maximal solution is g=g0 on R. Otherwise it is g0/(1-ct), on (−∞,c⁻¹) for c>0 and (c⁻¹,∞) for c<0. Under the specified identity-linear formal coupling change, the quadratic beta coefficient remains b. No omitted-term bound or ultraviolet-completion conclusion follows.
Assume Countable Choice. For all ρ,τ>0, Zρτ=Zρ∘(σρZτσρ⁻¹). If σρZτσρ⁻¹=Zτ for every ρ,τ>0, this reduces to Zρτ=Zρ∘Zτ.
